question: What is the value of 1 kWh in Joule(J)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3.6 × 10⁶**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1 kilowatt-hour (kWh)** is a unit of energy commonly used to measure **electricity consumption**.
 
• The **kilowatt-hour** is a derived unit of energy equal to **3.6 megajoules**.
 
• It is equivalent to the energy transferred or consumed when using **1 kilowatt of power for 1 hour**.
 
• In terms of **Joules (J)**, 1 kWh is calculated as: **1 kWh = 1 kW × 1 hour = 1000 watts × 3600 seconds = 3.6 × 10⁶ Joules**.
 
• This conversion is essential in various fields, including **electricity billing**, **energy management**, and **scientific calculations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **kWh**__

 
 
• The **kilowatt-hour (kWh)** is commonly used by **electricity providers** to calculate **energy consumption**.
 
• The kWh is also used to express the capacity of **batteries** in electric vehicles and other **electrical storage systems**.
 
• Understanding the conversion from kWh to Joules is crucial for accurate **energy assessments** and comparisons.
